verdicts.rationale: REST v2 API accepts mathematically invalid HNSW search parameters (ef=0, ef=-1, ef=9999999999) without validation and returns successful results. Source code confirms generateSearchParams() only converts parameters to KeyValuePair format without range checks. While internal/util/indexparamcheck/constraints.go defines HNSWMinEfConstruction = 1, this validation is not applied at search-time. This is a genuine parameter validation bug in the REST v2 layer, matching the documented 'rest-v2-data-type-handling' bug_shape pattern with 26 historical instances.
